title: beCasKAS pipeline parameters
description: Reproducible Nextflow pipeline for beCasKAS off-target base editor analysis

samplesheet.description: Path to samplesheet CSV with columns: sample_id, fastq_1, fastq_2, condition, replicate, background_id

refdir.description: Directory containing pre-staged hg38 references in a flat layout (all files at the top level, no subdirectories). Required files: hg38.fasta, hg38.fasta.fai, hg38.dict, hg38.genome (chrom sizes), hg38.{1,2,3,4,rev.1,rev.2}.bt2 (bowtie2 index prefix hg38), af-only-gnomad.hg38.vcf.gz(.tbi), 1000g_pon.hg38.vcf.gz(.tbi). User is responsible for staging these files; see README.

clip_r2.description: Bases to clip from 5' of R2 (adaptase library prep)

stage.description: Which stage(s) to run. 'all' = full pipeline; 'kas_analyzer' = stop after the per-case DiffBind samplesheets; 'diffbind' = run the differential + variant stage (use with -resume after a kas_analyzer run).

min_overlap.description: DiffBind minOverlap (peaks present in N+ samples to enter consensus)

n_pseudo_replicates.description: Pseudo-replicates per condition when only n=1 sample is provided

seed.description: Random seed used by R analyses and BAM-split partitioning

guidescan_grna.description: gRNA spacer (20 nt, no PAM) to search for in each case's differential peaks. When unset and no --guidescan_params is given, neither guidescan stage runs. For cases targeting different loci, set the spacer per case via --guidescan_params; this is the fallback for cases that JSON does not name.

guidescan_seed.description: Stage 1 seed: a substring of spacer+PAM that must match exactly ('N' = wildcard) for a peak to be anchored and scored. Defaults to the PAM-proximal 5 nt of the spacer plus the PAM (GGCACTGCGGCTGGAGGTGG + NGG -> GGTGGNGG). Longer is faster but leaves more peaks for stage 2; shorter is more sensitive but slower.

guidescan_mismatches.description: Stage 1: discard a scored site with more than this many mismatches. Applied after scoring, as a filter -- stage 1 does not search, so raising it costs nothing.

guidescan_chunk_size.description: Stage 1: peaks processed together as one padded-extraction unit

guidescan_summit_width.description: Stage 1: if >0, restrict the seed search to the centre N bp of each peak. LEAVE AT 0 (full peak) unless you have a specific reason -- a width of 100 was measured to miss the true on-target site in HEK4, HEK4_noSort, and CD7 (chr17:82316661-82316683 in peak chr17:82316540-82316940): the anchor was found but fell out of bounds for scoring.

skip_guidescan_enumerate.description: Skip stage 2, leaving stage 1's seed-anchored results as the only guidescan output. Stage 2 runs by default and recovers sites whose mismatch falls inside the seed, but it is orders of magnitude more expensive than stage 1 -- skip it for a fast first pass, or when a case's unanchored-peak count makes the runtime impractical.

guidescan_enumerate_mismatches.description: Stage 2 search budget -- separate from --guidescan_mismatches and deliberately lower, since cost grows as C(20,m)*3^m (~28M at m=6, ~826M at m=8, ~10.9B at m=10). 8 because at m=6 the mismatch distribution was still rising at the ceiling. DO NOT RAISE TO 10: a 150-peak run emitted 17.6M rows / 1.8 GB and did not finish in 2.5 h.

skip_protospacer.description: Skip PROTOSPACER, the final step that maps each background-subtracted variant onto its 1-based position within the predicted 20 nt protospacer and writes the figure set. It runs by default whenever a gRNA is configured, since it is the readout the rest of the differential stage exists to produce. Skip it for a run where only the intermediate tables are wanted, or on a container without r-patchwork.

guidescan_enumerate_chunk_size.description: Stage 2: peaks per GuideScan2 index+enumerate unit. Small on purpose -- each chunk's enum.csv is parsed single-threaded, so smaller chunks parallelise the scoring too.

partition.description: SLURM partition(s) for task jobs; a comma-separated list is allowed

clusterOptions.description: Extra raw flags appended to every task's sbatch call, e.g. '--qos=long'

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema at runtime

schema_ignore_params.description: Comma-separated list of parameter names to ignore during schema validation

container.description: Path to the Apptainer/Singularity/Docker image used by all processes
